## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `68ff0b24d8f7246075ba39a7b6b46023b68ff439`
Local-runs: none

The lane seat's own review of record, owed by the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` declaration alone (face `declaration`). No path of the diff is a published schema (`packages/spec` untouched) or a governed path.

### ① Derived judgments

- `@object-ui/i18n` (published) gains eight keys in each of the eleven locale packs (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, +12/-0 each): `home.connectAssistant.title`, `body`, `action`, `dismiss` and `console.firstRunChecklist.connectAssistant.title`, `todo`, `done`, `action`. No key is removed or reworded. A widening: `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is RIGHT.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`: the new exports `useConnectedAccess`, `ConnectedAccess`, `ConnectedEntry` and `connectAssistantPath` are not published surface. `useConnectedAccess` gains an optional `{ enabled }` argument (default `true`, so the Connect page's existing call is unchanged), and an adapter without the auth client now reads as `failed` instead of throwing out of the effect.
- `@object-ui/console` changes only `FirstRunChecklist.tsx` (a new row) and its test; no export changes.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is RIGHT: Home card and checklist row read existing records (`sys_oauth_consent` through `oauth.authorizedClients.list()`, `sys_api_key`); no metadata an author writes changes.
- Accept sets: no door changes. The row's done state is read from those records, never from a click, and a row or card whose read is out or failed is not drawn, so a failed read is never shown as "nothing connected".

### ② Semver level

- `patch` on `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`, with both declaration lines on the PR body and the changeset: RIGHT under ruling A.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `layout/AppHeader.tsx` gives its copy of the connect-page path rule to the new `connectAssistantPath.ts` (one rule, three readers), outside the claimed file list. Accepted: same feature, behaviour unchanged, its tests pass per the dev.
- The changeset also bumps `@object-ui/console`, because the checklist row lives there. Accepted.
- One "has connected" read: Home card and checklist row both call `useConnectedAccess`, the read #30898 built; no second copy.
- The claim said `Clause-②: no`; it is amended on the card to `yes (widening)` (as measured).
- `open_questions`: none.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-l2jntk`
Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5nLA7wiVY5YWjT9Svr`

**VERDICT: PASS**
